entries.en: The signal is coming from a mine?
Mineshaft. That's the source of the signal.
The signal's coming from a mine?
This smells.
A trap. It has to be.
Smells like ambush, skipper.
Smells like ambush, Commander.
I don't like this, Commander.
I concur. This did not crash. Someone moved it here.
I agree. This thing didn't crash. Somebody moved it here.
Yeah. This thing didn't crash. Somebody moved it here.
I agree. The probe didn't crash. Someone moved it here.
I agree. Your probe didn't crash. It was moved here.
All right, Shepard.
Aye, aye.
They may not know what they have. Let's find it before they set it off.
Your grasp of the obvious is inspiring. There's still a nuke down there. Check your corners and watch your back.
There's a nuclear weapon down there. We can't abandon it. Just stay on guard.
Whoever did it is in danger.
Doesn't change our objective.
Why am I not surprised?
What do we do now, Shepard?
Orders, Commander?
What do we do now, Commander?
That was a detonator. Someone just screwed us.
What the hell!
That was a detonator, Commander.
Seismic charge. Someone did that on purpose.
Shepard. At last.
You don't remember me. No matter. I remember you. I never forget anyone I've fought.
My name is Elanos Haliat. I doubt you know it.
Who do you think runs the Terminus Clans, Shepard? Hm? Thousands of pirates, slavers, criminals of every stripe?
The strongest leads.
The one who kills the most men. Seizes the most ships. Pillages the most colonies.
Three years ago, I was the strongest. I used my influence to assemble a fleet. We would drive your kind out of the Verge.
I was the motivator. The instigator. The one who promised glory and riches for sacking the largest human colony in the cluster.
Failed because of you. Your damnable holding action.
Empty words from a dead woman.
Empty words from a dead man.
Let them. We'll be ready. An Alliance warship would make a fine prize.
Oh, and if you hadn't noticed, the ores here are laced with heavy metals. I'm afraid your suit radios aren't powerful enough to transmit out.
I rather doubt that.
My crew will come for me.
You'll see me again, Haliat. Count on it.
We'll find a way out of here.
We've got air and light, and the Normandy's still in orbit. Let's look for another way out.
We find a way out. Someone up there needs my boot up his ass. See if there's anything in here we can use.
I don't know. Let me think. You two see if there's anything in here we can use.
You have me at a disadvantage.
You caused the cave-in? What's the meaning of this?
In most criminal organizations, it's the one who's recognized as the most successful.
You assume I give a damn. That's cute.
I don't study the internal politics of pirate bands.
You organized the attack on Elysium. You want me to thank you for my Star of Terra?
You're the one behind the attack on Elysium!
It doesn't have to be like this, Haliat.
"At last?"
An acclaimed leader.
Who cares?
How should I know?
You attacked Elysium!
Nice try, genius.
The Skyllian Blitz.
Can't we negotiate?
Call the Normandy.
I'll get you.
No one panic.
I'll kill him.
I'll think of something.
The one blamed when it failed.
I was ruined when your kind held against the Blitz. What better way to recover my reputation than by eliminating the first human Spectre?
You organized the attack on Elysium. Too bad we kicked your ass back into Terminus, huh?
